scripts.text:
DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @JobCode VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @FolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @DestinationFolder VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @SourceFolderPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @DestinationArchiveFolder VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TempTidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ProcessMonths VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @RootPath VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @ProcessJob VARCHAR(1)
DECLARE @Current_Date DATETIME
DECLARE @DestinationFileNamePattern VARCHAR(1000)

SET @Current_Date = GETDATE()
SET @EnvironName = (SELECT Top 1 Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @RootPath = ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDT..EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName = @EnvironName),'')
SET @JobCode = @0
SET @TidalJobNumber = @1

--if dev and running from visualstudio (instead of tidal), then put D in front
IF @EnvironName = 'Dev' AND @TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%'
BEGIN
 SET @TempTidalJobNumber = (SELECT MAX(TidalJobNumber) FROM EPSDTJobFile WHERE TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%')
 SET @TidalJobNumber = 'D' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(@TempTidalJobNumber, 'D', '')) + 1, 1))))
END

SET @JobId = (SELECT Top 1 JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = @JobCode)
SET @DestinationFolder = (SELECT Top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'DestinationFolder' and EnvironName = @EnvironName)
SET @FolderPath = (SELECT Top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FolderPath' and EnvironName = @EnvironName)
SET @DestinationArchiveFolder = (SELECT top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'DestinationArchiveFolder' and EnvironName = @EnvironName)
SET @DestinationFileNamePattern = (SELECT top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'DestinationFileNamePattern' and EnvironName = @EnvironName)

SET @ProcessMonths = (SELECT top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'ProcessMonths' and EnvironName = @EnvironName)
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM fnConvertListToStringTable(@ProcessMonths ,',') WHERE Item = MONTH(GETDATE()))
 SET @ProcessJob = '1' 
ELSE
 SET @ProcessJob = '0' 


SELECT TOP 1
JobId = @JobId,
JobCode = @JobCode,
SourceFolderPath = @RootPath + Replace(Replace(@FolderPath,'{YYYY}',cast(DatePart(yyyy,@Current_Date) as varchar)),'{MM}',Right('0' + cast(DatePart(month,@Current_Date) as varchar),2)),
FilePattern = (SELECT top 1 Value FROM EPSDTJobConfig WHERE JobId = @JobId AND ConfigKey = 'FilePattern' and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
DestinationFolder = @DestinationFolder,
DestinationArchiveFolder = @DestinationArchiveFolder,
DestinationFileNamePattern = @DestinationFileNamePattern,
TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber,
ProcessJob = @ProcessJob,
SuccessEmailTo = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobCompletionTo' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
FailureEmailTo = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobErrorTo' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
SucessEmailSubject = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobCompletionSubject' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
FailureEmailSubject = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobErrorSubject' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
SuccessEmailBody = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobCompletionBody' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName),
FailureEmailBody = (select top 1 Value from EPSDTJobConfig where ConfigKey = 'EmailJobErrorBody' and JobID = @JobId and EnvironName = @EnvironName)

DECLARE @FileToRename VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @FileToRenameValue VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @DestinationFolder VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @DestinationFileNamePattern VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @PRPR_ID VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @TIN INT

WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.1'

SET @FileToRename = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @DestinationFolder = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)
SET @DestinationFileNamePattern = concat(pipeline().parameters.BasePath, '/', @item().name)

SET @FileToRenameValue = REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(@FileToRename),0,CHARINDEX('\',REVERSE(@FileToRename))))
IF @FileToRenameValue Like 'EPSDT Gaps In Care%'
	SET @FileToRenameValue = REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(REPLACE(@FileToRenameValue,'.xlsx','')),0,CHARINDEX('_',REVERSE(REPLACE(@FileToRenameValue,'.xlsx','')))))
	
SET @PRPR_ID =  REVERSE(SUBSTRING(REVERSE(REPLACE(@FileToRenameValue,'.xlsx','')),0,CHARINDEX(' ',REVERSE(REPLACE(@FileToRenameValue,'.xlsx','')))))
SET @TIN = (SELECT ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(Provider_TAX_ID,0) FROM EPSDTProvider WHERE Provider = @PRPR_ID),0))

SET @DestinationFileNamePattern = REPLACE(@DestinationFileNamePattern,'{SourceFilename}.xlsx',@FileToRenameValue)
SET @DestinationFileNamePattern = REPLACE(@DestinationFileNamePattern,'{PRPR_ID}', @PRPR_ID)
SET @DestinationFileNamePattern = REPLACE(@DestinationFileNamePattern,'{TaxIDNumber}', Right('000000000' + cast(@TIN as varchar),9))

select @FileToRenameValue as FileToRenameValue,
@DestinationFolder+@FileToRenameValue as OldFileName,
@DestinationFolder+@DestinationFileNamePattern as NewFileName
